ITEM 1 | Golden-brown breaded piece, flaky crumb coating with darker browned spots and flecks of green herb pressed in, two overlapping pieces roughly 10 x 7 cm and 8 x 6 cm, moist-looking interior visible at edges, sits at top of plate upper-right of greens | 180
ITEM 2 | Shredded dark green leafy vegetable with pale green stem pieces, coated in a creamy off-white dressing with a fine grated light-colored sprinkle, slightly glossy and clinging to leaves, spread across lower-left of plate roughly 12 x 10 cm, low mound about 2 cm high, includes a few small pale yellow-green chunks | 110
